package.name: anvil_msgs
package.description: Anvil custom ROS 2 message definitions. CommandedEEPose — target end-effector pose + gripper opening. Wire-compatible with anvil-workcell's copy — real hardware depends on this shape staying identical across both repos. MockEEPose — fake-hardware-only extension (composes CommandedEEPose + a sequence counter); never used against real hardware.
